g.text: - the pull request is not CONFLICTING
- every required check passed on the head commit
- the pull request is not CONFLICTING
- a required check failed on the head commit
- the pull request is not CONFLICTING
- no required check failed, and a required check
has not reported on the head commit
- checks_wait_time is over, counted from the later
one of the label time and the head commit time
(the time of the poll is an input value)
Sort the R1, R4, and I1 candidates
by priority label (highest first; no label last),
and keep as many as the free slots
- an APPROVED review of a person
on the head commit of the pull request
- a CHANGES_REQUESTED review of a person
on the head commit of the pull request,
Collect I14 candidates of the Owner's review
- each open pull request that closes an issue
from the issue in this snapshot
I14 of the Owner's review, I11, in this order)
Apply (in the order of the list)
I14: change the label to cumin/status/implementing,
then ask the Implementer to resolve the conflict
I3: change the label to cumin/status/reviewing
I4: fix requests below the limit?
count one more, change the label to
a fix in the same session
hand it back to the Owner (row I4)
hand it back to the Owner (row I15) with
the head commit, the required checks that
have not reported, and the time waited
R1: change the label to cumin/status/planning,
then ask the Planner to split
I1: change the label to cumin/status/implementing,
If a label does not change,
try again at the next poll
I12: read the permission of each reviewer,
and when the latest review of an Owner approves
the head commit, run the merge step
I13: read the permission of each reviewer,
and when the latest review of an Owner requests
changes on the head commit, after the last
to address that review in the same session
I14 of the Owner's review: when I12 and I13
did not take the issue at this poll,
then ask the Implementer to resolve the conflict
I11 copies the labels of the issue as this poll
read them. A label that this poll or the end of
a run (I2) changed reaches the pull request
I11: make the labels of the pull request
